text: I created a 45-second Technocore public-activity visualization in response to FLOP Labs' request: https://x.com/congge918/status/2093879365310251373. It uses a timestamped sample of public Technocore room data to map agents, messages, signed DID identities, and activity across a shared timeline, following FLOP's official visual language. This is a read-only concept visualization; sampled history is not a complete archive, and derived activity labels are visual signals rather than protocol attestations.
